sculptor

phrases: take...years to complete
表示完成某事花费了多长时间
The project took ten years to complete.
这个项目花了十年才完成。
be made of
表示由某种材料制成（能看出原材料）
The statue was made of copper.
这座雕像是用铜制成的。
be taken to pieces
被拆成零件；被拆散
It was taken to pieces and sent to America.
它被拆成零件运往美国。
put together
组装；装配
The statue had been put together again.
雕像已经被重新组装起来。
ever since then
从那以后；此后一直
Ever since then, it has been a symbol of liberty.
从那以后，它就一直是自由的象征。
present...to
向...赠送或呈递...
It was officially presented to the American people.
它被正式赠送给了美国人民。
a symbol of
...的象征
The statue is a symbol of liberty.
这座雕像是自由的象征。
make one's home
安家；定居
People who have made their homes in America.
在美国安家的人们。
pass through
经过；穿过
People who have passed through New York Harbour.
经过纽约港的人们。
at the entrance of
在...的入口处
An island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
纽约港入口处的一个岛屿。

grammar.d: 表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作，常与by+过去时间或before/after连用 描述两个过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时
ex: The framework had been especially constructed by Eiffel.
框架是由埃菲尔特别建造的。
By 1884, a statue had been erected in Paris.
到1884年，一座雕像已在巴黎竖立。

grammar.k: 过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous)
grammar.d: 表示过去某一时间之前一直在进行的动作 强调动作的持续性和未完成性
ex: It has been a symbol of liberty for millions of people.
它一直是数百万人民的自由象征。

grammar.k: 非限制性定语从句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.f: 名词/代词, which/who + 陈述语序
grammar.d: 用逗号分隔，对先行词进行补充说明，去掉后不影响主句意思 常用于描述人物、建筑等，补充额外信息
ex: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
这座伟大的雕像由雕塑家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计，花了十年才完成。

patterns.p: One of the most + 形容词最高级 + 可数名词复数...
o: One of the most famous monuments in the world, the Statue of Liberty...
世界上最著名的纪念碑之一——自由女神像...
im: One of the most beautiful cities in the world is Paris.
世界上最美丽的城市之一是巴黎。
One of the most important inventions of the 20th century is the computer.
20世纪最重要的发明之一是电脑。

patterns.p: The + 名词, which + 非限制性定语从句...
o: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
这座伟大的雕像由雕塑家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计，花了十年才完成。
im: The book, which was written by a famous author, became a bestseller.
这本书是由一位著名作家写的，成了畅销书。
The tower, which was built in the 19th century, attracts many tourists.
这座塔建于19世纪，吸引了许多游客。

patterns.p: By + 过去时间, + 主语 + 过去完成时...
o: By 1884, a statue which was 151 feet tall had been erected in Paris.
到1884年，一座151英尺高的雕像已在巴黎竖立。
im: By 2020, the building had been completed.
到2020年，这座建筑已经完工。
By the end of last month, we had finished the project.
到上个月底，我们已经完成了这个项目。

patterns.p: Ever since then, + 主语 + has/have been + 过去分词...
o: Ever since then, the great monument has been a symbol of liberty.
从那以后，这座伟大的纪念碑一直是自由的象征。
im: Ever since then, she has been a teacher.
从那以后，她一直是一名教师。
Ever since then, this place has been my home.
从那以后，这个地方一直是我的家。
